items.prompt: Why should a rejected fill preserve both economic values AND accepted-ID count?

options.text: Otherwise a retry could be blocked or state partly committed
options.why: The stated rejection contract covers all observable state.

options.text: Only cash ever affects later execution
options.why: Inventory and identity count affect acceptance too.

options.text: Every rejected fill is an accepted trade
options.why: It is not accepted by this synthetic component.

options.text: An unchanged printed status proves all hidden state
options.why: The test must inspect snapshots/reference behavior.

items.explanation: Identity/resource state is part of the commit contract, not just the amount printed.
